title: State Theatre

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Located less than a block away from The Commons in the heart of downtown Ithaca, The State Theatre, is an excellent choice for a wide range of special events. Originally constructed as a vaudeville house in 1928, this historic building features a beautiful, ornate lobby, amazing sight-lines from every seat in the house, ample green rooms and brand new restroom facilities. With a seating capacity of 1,600, the building is perfectly suited to accommodate a wide range of events.
